note: Yosemite National Park campground in mixed conifer forest beside Hodgdon Meadow, half a mile inside the Big Oak Flat entrance and 25 miles from Yosemite Valley; paved roads and spurs, a food locker at every site. Most sites are hike-in tent sites; only the drive-in sites take an RV, so check the site's own length. No cell service or public phone. Showers and the dump station are in the Valley. The park entrance fee is extra. --Claude
